newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuelan bolivar ends down at 476/477 dlr.
newsitem.headline: Venezuelan bolivar ends down at 476/477 dlr.

text.p: The Venezuelan bolivar closed slightly down at 476.00/477.00 bolivars per dollar in a market hit by strong corporate demand, brokers said.
Trading resumed Tuesday after the Epiphany bank holiday. On Friday, the unit closed at 476.00/476.75.
"There was strong demand above all from corporate clients," one trader said. It pushed the parity down to 476.50/477.50 at one point until the Central Bank intervened, another trader said.
Most brokers expect little fluctuation in days to come as long as the Central Bank, one said, "keeps a watchful eye on the exchange rate."
